features: Oath of the Crown: Channel Divinity 1/rest + oath spells always prepared.
Champion Challenge: action; creatures within 30 ft (WIS save) cannot move >30 ft away for 1 minute.
Turn the Tide: bonus; allies within 30 ft below half HP heal 1d6+CHA.
Lay on Hands: healing pool 5 HP per long rest.
Courageous Inspiration (Amulet of Mieszko) 2/day: cannot be frightened; advantage on STR checks/saves; melee attacks deal +2 damage for 1 minute.

notes: Level 3 Paladin (Oath of the Crown). Channel Divinity 1/rest: Champion Challenge and Turn the Tide. Divine Health: immune to disease. Slots 3×1st; Lay on Hands pool 5 HP; Divine Sense 3/day.
